title: Can I SURVIVE Horde Chess?
summary: chess.com Horde vs online humans: White has 36 pawns (no king) vs Black's normal army. White wins by checkmating Black's king; Black wins by capturing all of White's pawns/pieces. Tony plays Black in games 1-2 (stalemates one by premove, loses one) and finally wins game 3 as White vs the highest-rated opponent by promoting and skewering.
rules: White: 36 pawns filling ranks 1-4 plus extra pawns on rank 5 (b5,c5,f5,g5), no king.
White wins by checkmate; Black wins by capturing every White unit.
White pawns on rank 1 may double-step (chess.com rule); normal promotion.
win_condition: As White: checkmate Black. As Black: capture all White pieces.

board.theme_notes: chess.com; thumbnail: white king surrounded by black pawns, 'Horde Chess?'

current_impl_issues: Verify impl uses the 36-pawn horde for one side with the capture-all win for the other; player played both colours.
